about: The Minpentai hall as a grey-box set: tiers all round, the standing ring at the top, the broad walkway across the middle (owner, 2026-10-16), the floor of posts and holograms with nobody on it, the two pits, two big screens.

objects.landmark: tiers of seats rising all around the hall, full of a varied crowd
the standing ring around the top of the hall, crowded behind a railing
the broad walkway spanning the hall high above the floor, with a railing on each side
identical black posts on small robotic bases, glowing cube clusters on top
glowing holograms of gliders, little ships and walls of cubes in cyan and amber over the floor
Deluin's sunken pit at the edge of the floor
Kau's sunken pit at the edge of the floor
two big screens hung over the hall, showing the two players' faces

A.what: the whole hall from the standing ring on the south-west, the walkway crossing the frame

B.what: low on the floor among the posts

P.what: down into Deluin's pit, the tiers rising behind

W.what: the walkway from the air beside it, the floor below

V.what: straight down from the walkway's railing to the floor
